description: Report cites two real transactions, neither of which is gold-relevant -- both precision and recall are zero, but f1 is undefined (not 0) since precision + recall = 0.
report_text: Also of note: T1-002 and T1-003.
flag: F1 is null here, not 0.0, because ComputeTraceability only computes F1 when precision + recall > 0 (guards a 0/0 division). Both precision and recall are well-defined 0.0 individually, but their harmonic mean is left undefined rather than reported as 0. A consumer that treats a null F1 as 'not evaluated' rather than 'evaluated as zero' would need to check precision/recall directly to catch this specific complete-miss case.
